page.notes: Blank leaf: no printed text. Omitted as not printed on the page: the digitiser's credit block and the scan's dark border. A small smudge or speck in the upper left of the leaf is a stain, not a printed mark. The left edge shows the book's gutter and the edges of neighbouring leaves (show-through or edge of adjoining page), which are not transcribed.
